title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Senior analytics engineer
description:
Company Description
United Hub Digital (UHD) is a nearshore IT consulting firm helping mid and large US enterprise clients accelerate their data and technology initiatives. Headquartered in Greenville, SC, with a delivery hub in Brazil, we embed directly into client teams as a trusted execution partner across data analytics, software development, UI/UX, and project management. We hold ourselves to the same standards of accountability and delivery quality our clients expect from their own teams.About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to 'make the data AI-ready': well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.
Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What You Will Do
Semantic Modeling
Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.)
Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer
Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumptionData Documentation and Context
Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog
Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadataAI Readiness
Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scopeGovernance and Quality
Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Qualifications
Required
5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
Hands-on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act onNice to Have
Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases
Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Business process analyst i
description:
Descrição da função:1. Design e Documentação de Processos GTM
Documentar e aprimorar os principais processos de execução de GTM (Go-To-Market), incluindo:
Transferência de leads e demanda
Fluxo de oportunidades e negociações
Adoção, renovações e estratégias de expansão

Alinhar definições e uso das métricas entre as equipes
Criar visualizações simples ou dashboards para identificar problemas e riscos na execução
Usar insights para recomendar melhorias específicas nos processos
3. Colaboração Multifuncional
Facilitar reuniões de trabalho com times de Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e Operações
Registrar decisões e transformá-las em documentação clara
Apoiar iniciativas das equipes com análises estruturadas e acompanhamento contínuo

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando aevolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiênciasinteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!O desafio
Buscamos umSenior Data Engineerpara liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você teráalto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.O que você vai fazer:
Desenhar, implementar e evoluir aarquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo delakehousena AWS;
Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos desegurança, governança e compliance ;
Lidar comdados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base paraprodutos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.O que esperamos de você:
Experiência sólida comoData Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
Domínio de Python e SQLpara construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
Experiência prática comAWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
Conhecimento e uso deInfraestrutura como Código (Ia C) ;
Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação comsegurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
Experiência emambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.Benefícios que oferecemos:
Modelo remoto prioritário
Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
Day off no aniversário

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. You be your own boss and set your own schedule

title: Llm scientist
description:

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-drivenFX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus onAfrican (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)orLATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets.
Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions.
Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implementFX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant.
Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automatedhedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools

Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market Development

Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets.
Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades.Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:

Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks

FX trading systems

Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications
Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.

description:

ComoEngenheiro(a) de Software Principalna equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.
O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Nosso objetivo é economizar tempo eliminando redundâncias e oferecendo uma única plataforma que equipes inteiras podem usar para compartilhar informações de forma eficaz. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.Responsabilidades
Projetar, codificar, testar, depurar e documentar novas e existentes funcionalidades para garantir que a aplicação atenda às necessidades de negócio, qualidade e operação
Construir código robusto e de alta qualidade e estabelecer/manter altos padrões de qualidade e testes
Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software
Interpretar e traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e tarefas
Aplicar habilidades de resolução de problemas técnicos para projetar soluções de arquitetura seguras e escaláveis
Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataformaQualificações mínimas
Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)
Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria

title: Coordenador De Obras - Incorporação
description:
Oportunidade: Coordenador de Obras (Incorporação)

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Obras com perfil dinâmico e visão estratégica para integrar nosso time de Engenharia. Este profissional será o elo entre o planejamento da incorporadora e a execução técnica no canteiro, garantindo que nossos empreendimentos sejam entregues com excelência, dentro do prazo e do orçamento.Requisitos Fundamentais (Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência Comprovada: Vivência sólida na coordenação de múltiplas obras simultâneas no segmento de incorporação imobiliária (residencial ou comercial).
  • Formação: Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil com registro ativo no CREA.
  • Visão de Incorporação: Entendimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto imobiliário (do projeto à entrega das chaves/assistência técnica).
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
  • Gestão Multiobras: Coordenar simultaneamente o andamento de diferentes canteiros, garantindo a padronização de processos e qualidade.
  • Interface Estratégica: Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas de Projetos, Suprimentos e Financeiro da Incorporadora.
  • Controle de Cronograma: Monitorar o caminho crítico das obras, antecipar riscos e propor planos de ação para desvios de prazo.
  • Gestão de Custos: Acompanhar o fluxo de caixa das obras e o cumprimento do orçamento previsto (VGV/Custos diretos).
  • Liderança de Equipes: Orientar os engenheiros residentes e equipes técnicas, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance e segurança.
  • Qualidade e Normas: Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas, PBQP-H e legislações municipais vigentes.
Pré-requisitos Adicionais e Diferenciais
  • Softwares de Gestão: Domínio de ferramentas de planejamento (MS Project ou Primavera) e ERPs de engenharia (Ex: Sienge, UAU ou Totvs).
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Lean Construction (Construção Enxuta) para otimização de processos.
  • Gestão de Contratos: Habilidade na contratação e gestão de grandes empreiteiras e fornecedores críticos.
  • Pós-Graduação: Especialização em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão de Negócios Imobiliários ou Engenharia de Custos será considerada um diferencial.
  • Perfil Comportamental: Forte capacidade de negociação, resiliência para lidar com prazos desafiadores e excelente comunicação interpessoal.

title: Mestre De Obras
description:
No Iberostar Group estamos à procura de um/a Mestre de Obras para se juntar à nossa equipe de Construção na nosso Hotel em Paria do Forte, Brasil, mas antes de saber mais sobre a posição, acreditamos que é importante que saibas um pouco sobre o Iberostar Group:

  • Somos uma empresa 100% familiar com 70 anos de experiência no setor do turismo. Hoje acolhemos milhões de viajantes com a promessa de criar férias felizes e experiências memoráveis, com uma proposta de valor baseada na qualidade e na experiência do cliente e do colaborador.
  • Operamos mais de 100 estabelecimentos distribuídos por 35 destinos em 13 países em todo o mundo, localizados em zonas privilegiadas junto ao mar.
  • Fazemos parte de uma família com mais de 35.000 pessoas de 95 nacionalidades, que partilham os mesmos valores: Responsabilidade, Transparência, Humildade, Paixão e Criatividade.
  • Trabalhamos para criar um lugar onde prosperar: cuidamos das pessoas que fazem parte da família Iberostar, promovendo o seu crescimento, garantindo o seu bem-estar e incentivando a equidade como base das nossas decisões.
  • O nosso movimento Iberostar Wave of Change é o nosso roteiro para impulsionar o nosso propósito de liderar um modelo de turismo responsável.

Missão do Cargo

Responsável por planejar, coordenar e supervisionar a execução das atividades no canteiro de obras, garantindo que os serviços sejam realizados conforme projetos, especificações técnicas, prazos estabelecidos, padrões de qualidade e normas de segurança.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Planejamento e Organização da Obra

  • Organizar e planejar as frentes de trabalho conforme cronograma da obra.
  • Definir a distribuição das equipes e acompanhar a produtividade dos serviços.
  • Garantir que as atividades estejam alinhadas com o planejamento definido pela engenharia.

Coordenação da Equipe

  • Supervisionar encarregados, cabos de turma e equipes operacionais.
  • Orientar tecnicamente os trabalhadores na execução dos serviços.
  • Garantir que as equipes estejam adequadamente dimensionadas para cada atividade.

Controle da Execução

Acompanhar a execução de serviços como:

  • Fundações, estruturas, alvenaria, formas e armação, concretagem, revestimentos e acabamentos;
  • Garantir que osserviços sejam executados conforme projetos, memoriais descritivos e orientações da engenharia.

Controle de Materiais e Equipamentos

  • Acompanhar o recebimento e utilização de materiais no canteiro.
  • Informar à engenharia a necessidade de compras ou reposição de materiais.
  • Garantir o uso correto de equipamentos e ferramentas.

Qualidade da Obra

  • Verificar qualidade dos serviços executados.
  • Identificar e corrigir falhas construtivas durante a execução.
  • Garantir que os padrões técnicos e construtivos sejam cumpridos.

Segurança do Trabalho

  • Garantir que todas as atividades sejam executadas conforme as normas de segurança do trabalho.
  • Fiscalizar o uso de EPIs pela equipe.
  • Apoiar ações de prevenção de acidentes no canteiro.

Comunicação com a Engenharia

  • Reportar ao engenheiro responsável o andamento das atividades.
  • Informar problemas técnicos ou necessidades da obra.
  • Apoiar no controle de produtividade e planejamento das atividades.

Requisitos do Cargo:

Formação

  • Ensino fundamental ou médio completo.
  • Desejável cursos técnicos na área da construção civil.

Experiência

  • Experiência comprovada como Mestre de Obras ou Encarregado Geral em construção civil.

Conhecimentos

  • Leitura e interpretação de projetos (arquitetônico, estrutural e instalações).
  • Técnicas construtivas.
  • Planejamento e execução de obras.
  • Organização de canteiro de obras.
  • Noções de segurança do trabalho.

Parece desafiador? Cadastre-se e teremos prazer em fornecer mais informações. Junte-se à equipe!

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;

Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Home Office;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Engenheiro De Software Senior Backend (Ruby On Rails)
description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial.

O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida.

Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento.

Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada.

Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT;
studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore;
e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária.


Principais responsabilidades:

1.Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica

  • Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
  • Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e WebMock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
  • Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (PostgreSQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento


2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)

  • Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
  • Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
  • Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.


3. Colaboração e Alinhamento

  • Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
  • Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do "Rails Way".


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
  • Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.


5. Documentação e Sustentabilidade

  • Documentação Técnica: Manter uma documentação clara e atualizada da API (ex: Swagger/OpenAPI) para servir como fonte única de verdade para os times de consumo.
  • Manutenibilidade: Equilibrar o pragmatismo da entrega rápida com a saúde do código, garantindo uma base sólida para a evolução permanente do produto.


O que buscamos

Pessoas que:


  • Dominam Ruby on Rails (Modo API): Domínio profundo do framework, priorizando o "Rails Way" e o uso de scaffolding eficiente para velocidade de entrega.
  • Têm experiência em Design de API RESTful: Experiência em estruturar endpoints que atendam simultaneamente Web e Mobile (JSON, paginação, versionamento).
  • Têm experiência em Testes e Mocking (RSpec): Domínio de VCR e WebMock para simular interações externas de forma determinística, garantindo uma suíte de testes rápida e confiável.
  • Têm experiência em Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com PostgreSQL e uso eficiente de Active Record (evitando o problema de N+1).
  • Têm experiência com Autenticação e Segurança: Implementação prática de JWT ou Devise Token Auth.
  • Têm Pragmatismo e Foco: Foco em resolver o problema de negócio com a solução mais simples e direta, evitando "overengineering".
  • Têm Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Habilidade de alinhar contratos de API antecipadamente com os times de Front-end e Mobile para evitar bloqueios e garantir que a integração seja fluida.
  • Trabalham com Antecipação de Riscos (Atitude Dono): Capacidade de identificar gargalos ou requisitos ambíguos precocemente, levantando a mão e propondo soluções para evitar retrabalhos.
  • Trabalham em Equipe: Mentalidade colaborativa, compartilhando conhecimento e garantindo que o código seja legível e mantível para o restante do time.
  • Têm Autonomia: Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas alinhadas às convenções do Rails sem necessidade de microgerenciamento.


Diferencial (IA):

  • Uso de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a escrita de código e geração de mocks de dados.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas, abertas a pessoas de todos os perfis e experiências.

Ative o seu potencial com a gente. Candidate-se e venha crescer com o Grupo Smart Fit.

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.G., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

title: Vfx- Subject Matter Expert
description:
VFX- Fully Remote Subject Matter Expert


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting 3D Artists and VFX experts with experience creating computer generated scenes and assets to join our global network for a high level gaming project.


Rather than traditional VFX work, we are offering an opportunity to licence existing ‘on-the-shelf’ works from your archives, plus hourly compensation for technical processing.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Asset licencing: Licence existing works from your personal/ studio archives for a flat fee
  • Technical processing including rendering, layering, and preparing these files to our data specifications
  • In some cases, making variations to scenes and re-rendering


Please note: This is a "bench" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching


What You’ll Bring

  • Experience as a 3D, Technical or VFX Artist or Compositor in games, film or digital production
  • Experience with Unreal Engine, Unity & Houdini, Maya / Blender / Cinema4D and similar
  • Expertise in rendering, lighting and texturing
  • Comfortable using technical workflows and tools
  • Existing assets for licensing, with scenes separated into coherent, compositable layers


Nice To Have

  • Experience in the Gaming industry
  • Elements including depth, albedo, shading, gloss, cryptomat
  • Complex occlusions, atmospherics and crowd dynamics


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again;
simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.



Why join this project?

This is an opportunity to licence your existing assets and to apply your expertise in VFX design on a flexible, ad hoc basis, in order to help improve AI systems for video generation with better controllability for creators.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:
Job Title: Generative AI Associate – Portuguese

Location: Brazil – Remote work

Language: Portuguese

Time Commitment - 5-6 hours per day


About the role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and creative Generative AI Associates to join our team.

We are building a team of evaluators to assess the quality of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). This role focuses on ensuring responses are not only linguistically accurate, but also culturally relevant and aligned with regional nuances across Brazil.

You will play a key role in improving how AI systems communicate with Brazilian users by identifying gaps in tone, cultural context, and localization.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Write and refine prompts in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) to test model behavior across a variety of scenarios
  • Interact directly with the LLM in real time to evaluate responses and explore edge cases
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Assess outputs for:
  • Cultural relevance and appropriateness
  • Local idioms, tone, and natural phrasing
  • Regional variations across Brazil
  • Accuracy and clarity of information
  • Compare multiple responses and determine which performs best based on defined criteria
  • Provide clear, structured feedback to improve model performance
  • Flag issues such as unnatural phrasing, cultural mismatches, or misleading content Follow detailed evaluation guidelines and maintain consistency across tasks
  • Collaborating closely with language specialists, team leads, and QA leads to produce the best possible work
  • Hit productivity targets for number of prompts written and average handling time per prompt

What we need you to bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above or associates and 1 year of relevant industry experience or high school degree and 2 years of relevant industry experience
  • Native fluency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian culture, regional differences, and linguistic nuances
  • Excellent reading comprehension and attention to detail
  • Ability to apply guidelines consistently and make objective judgments
  • Comfort working with structured evaluation frameworks and annotation tools
  • Excellent writing skills (in Portuguese)
  • Strong understanding of grammar, syntax, and semantics
  • Ability to adopt different voices and points of view
  • Creative thinking
  • Strong attentive to detail
  • Well-honed internet research skills
  • Ability to embrace diverse teams
  • Ability to navigates ambiguity with grace
  • Adaptability to thrive in a dynamic environment, with the agility to adjust to evolving guidelines and requirements

title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.


Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment


Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.

title: Engenheiro De Dados Sênior - Oracle Cloud
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior - Oracle Cloud (OCI)


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados, com foco em arquitetura, integração e processamento de dados na Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em uma arquitetura medallion (Bronze, Prata e Ouro,, integrando fontes heterogêneas — incluindo Oracle Fusion Analytics, APIs, Bancos de Dados e plataformas diversas — garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das informações utilizadas pelas áreas de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados em ambientes Oracle Cloud, com foco em Oracle Cloud Data Integration e Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).

- Extrair e harmonizar dados do Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), consolidando informações financeiras e operacionais no Data Lake.

- Modelar e estruturar dados nas camadas analíticas para suportar soluções de BI e relatórios analíticos em Power BI.

- Trabalhar com processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT) respeitando a arquitetura de camadas do Data Lake.

- Apoiar a construção e manutenção do Catálogo de Dados no OCI, incluindo descoberta, linhagem e glossário.

- Garantir boas práticas de governança, qualidade e segurança de dados.

- Atuar em colaboração com times de arquitetura, analytics e áreas de negócio para entender demandas e propor soluções escaláveis.


Requisitos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

- Experiência com OCI Data Integration ou ferramenta equivalente de orquestração e transformação de dados em Oracle Cloud.

- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.

- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.

- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).

- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).

- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.

- Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas a dados (Python ou similar).


Diferenciais:

- Experiência com Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) — extração e entendimento do modelo de dados do Fusion.

- Vivência com Oracle Data Catalog para gestão de metadados e linhagem de dados.

- Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) para integração de sistemas.

- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados.


Modelo de Trabalho

- Remoto

- Contratação PJ


Benefícios ATRA:

- TotalPass

- Reembolso 100% em certificações

- Parcerias educacionais

- Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas

- Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: Gestão de Sede - TETO Bahia
description:
Overview


Você acredita que liderar também é estar no território, ouvir, decidir e transformar realidades? Então segue, porque essa vaga pode ser sobre você. A TETO Brasil atua há 20 anos no Brasil enfrentando a pobreza de forma concreta, ao lado de moradores e moradoras de comunidades invisibilizadas. Fazemos isso mobilizando milhares de voluntários, construindo moradias emergenciais e desenvolvendo projetos comunitários que fortalecem o protagonismo local e geram impacto social real. Estamos presentes em diversos estados do país e fazemos parte de uma rede latino-americana que acredita na ação coletiva como motor de mudança.


Agora, buscamos uma pessoa para assumir a Gestão de Sede – Bahia, um papel estratégico, de liderança e de muita presença. Essa função é para quem gosta de pensar grande, colocar a mão na massa e liderar pessoas com propósito.


Essa pessoa será responsável por conduzir a operação da sede no território, garantindo que a estratégia institucional da TETO saia do papel e aconteça de verdade. Será referência na promoção da cultura, dos valores e do modelo de trabalho da organização, liderando a atuação social e operacional, fortalecendo o voluntariado, viabilizando mutirões de moradia e projetos comunitários e garantindo impacto social com qualidade, eficiência e sustentabilidade.


Desafio e Responsabilidades



  • Liderar de forma integrada a operação da sede, sendo referência na promoção da cultura, dos valores e da missão da TETO, garantindo alinhamento, eficiência operacional e foco em impacto social;

  • Garantir a correta aplicação do modelo de trabalho da TETO nos territórios, assegurando protagonismo comunitário, coerência metodológica, uso adequado das ferramentas institucionais e qualidade das entregas;

  • Liderar a mobilização, gestão, formação e desenvolvimento das equipes de voluntariado, assegurando a execução do ciclo de voluntariado conforme o Plano V e fortalecendo a autonomia, o engajamento e a capacidade operativa da sede;

  • Planejar, gerir e garantir a realização de mutirões de moradia e projetos comunitários de excelência, assegurando gestão financeira, de prazos e de indicadores, bem como impacto territorial positivo e sustentabilidade da operação;

  • Desenvolver e acompanhar o planejamento operativo da sede, incluindo metas de moradia, projetos, voluntariado e expansão territorial, com gestão eficaz da informação para suporte à tomada de decisão;

  • Coordenar estrategicamente a atuação e a expansão territorial da sede, acompanhando eventos massivos, prospecção de comunidades, aplicação de enquetes e produção de dados socioeconômicos, garantindo retorno das informações aos territórios;

  • Articular e fortalecer parcerias institucionais locais (1º, 2º e 3º setor), ampliando redes de apoio que potencializem a atuação nos territórios e a sustentabilidade da sede;

  • Promover e liderar a captação de recursos local, fortalecendo o relacionamento com doadores e parceiros e sendo responsável final pelo cumprimento das metas financeiras da sede;

  • Representar institucionalmente a TETO, atuando como porta-voz junto a parceiros, imprensa, eventos e espaços públicos quando necessário;

  • Estar presente estrategicamente em territórios, acompanhando grandes mutirões, projetos comunitários e momentos críticos da operação para garantir excelência, fortalecer relacionamentos e apoiar decisões-chave.


Buscamos alguém com ensino superior completo, experiência em liderança de equipes e gestão de projetos, boa comunicação, escuta ativa e capacidade de tomar decisões em contextos complexos.


É fundamental ter afinidade com trabalho em territórios populares, voluntariado, desenvolvimento comunitário e temas ligados à desigualdade social e ao direito à moradia. Experiência com captação de recursos, relações institucionais e planejamento estratégico conta muitos pontos.


Ter vivência prévia na TETO ou em projetos sociais semelhantes é um diferencial importante.


É necessário residir ou ter disponibilidade para morar na Região Metropolitana de Salvador e ter disponibilidade para participar de atividades voluntárias aos finais de semana nas comunidades. O modelo de contratação é PJ.
